youtube.title: AI Email Reply in 14 Languages — MailMind Chrome Extension for Gmail
youtube.description:
MailMind is an AI email assistant that lives inside Gmail.
Understand any foreign language email and reply perfectly — in 14 languages with cultural context.

✦ Key Features
• 14-language support: EN / KR / JP / CN / ES / DE / PT / AR / IT / FR / and more
• Cultural context — replies that feel native, not just translated
• Industry auto-detection — IT, finance, legal terms applied automatically
• Tone control — professional, detailed, friendly, concise
• 3 reply options to compare + Smart Reply
• Thread summary — understand long conversations instantly
• Task extraction — deadlines and follow-ups auto-flagged
• Direct Gmail integration — insert reply with one click
• Signature & template settings

🔰 Pro Plan: 300 replies/month
🌐 mailmind.yongcha.app
